_readme: The mythics' pictures (16 Oct, docs/design/mythics.md): seven jobs, written to the LIVE names art/items/<slug>.png at the base's footprint x 64 px, as the gap uniques' were. Until a file exists the cell draws the base's picture (the test art). Run: python3 tools/make_mythic_manifest.py, then godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_items_mythics_manifest.json (++ --dry-run to list; ++ --only <slug> ++ --force to redo one).

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a single old bolt-action .303 rifle seen exactly side-on with the muzzle pointing left, laid level and filling the frame left to right: a brass pub bell tied to the sling swivel, the stock carved with the names of a dozen pubs, scorch marks, frost, green stains and a cut along the barrel as if every kind of harm had passed through it. It is the one of its kind in the country, kept and cared for when nothing else is: a faint warm red-orange glow lies along one edge of it, like the last of a sunset on metal, subtle and natural. One object centred and filling the frame, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with fine detail and painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background.
